name_en: Shiobiki-zushi — salt-cured salmon pressed onto sushi rice for celebrations
summary_ja: 塩漬けにしたサケを薄く切り、すし飯とともに木枠で押しずしにする米沢の祝い料理。サケの赤とすし飯の白が紅白に映えることから婚礼などの席に欠かせない一品として、内陸の米沢で育まれてきたという。
summary_en: Thin slices of salt-cured salmon are pressed with sushi rice in a wooden mold — a celebratory dish of Yonezawa. The salmon's red against the rice's white reads as an auspicious red-and-white pairing, and it is said to have taken root in this inland city where fresh fish was hard to come by.
source_title: 塩引きずし 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
